name: BATNA Cultivation and Boundary Hardening
scenario: Senior engineering executive negotiating an executive equity package while holding a verified, fully funded offer from an enterprise competitor.
script: "I have secured a formal offer from a tier-one competitor providing $240,000 in base salary paired with an accelerated four-year vesting schedule. While my strong preference is to lead your infrastructure modernization, I cannot economically rationalize an agreement that provides inferior long-term terminal value."
defense: Reframe their criteria: their offer buys base pay now; ours buys long-term equity in a market-dominant ecosystem.
originFull: Asymmetric Power Dynamics research indicates that a negotiator's structural power correlates directly with the quality and subjective valuation of their Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement. A robust alternative establishes a high reservation price and diminishes psychological susceptibility to coercive tactics.
defenseFull: When a counterparty relies heavily on an external alternative, reframe their criteria: "Their offer prioritizes immediate base compensation over enterprise scale. If near-term liquidity is your sole optimization variable, their structure fits; if you want long-term equity appreciation within a market-dominant ecosystem, our trajectory is unmatched."
